title: ComfyUI Qwen-Image 2.1
description: Qwen-Image 2.1 on ComfyUI, built from the original Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1 weights: the diffusers shards are converted (merged, renamed, SwiGLU-fused) into ComfyUI checkpoints on first start. Comfy Kitchen INT8 attention, baked node packs, network-volume aware. Set the endpoint's cached model to Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1 so the 30 GB of source shards are read from the host cache instead of downloaded.

input.name: Hugging Face token
input.description: Only needed for gated repos or to raise Hugging Face rate limits; the models used here are public

input.name: Model storage
input.description: auto (network volume when mounted, else container), volume, or container

input.name: Skip model download
input.description: Do not check or fetch any model on start (use when the volume is already populated)

input.name: Strict model setup
input.description: Exit instead of starting when a model cannot be prepared (recommended)

input.name: Use RunPod cached models
input.description: link | copy | off - adopt files staged by the endpoint's cached model instead of downloading them

input.name: Cold start timeout (s)
input.description: Seconds before an unfinished cold start is marked unhealthy (RunPod default 420); raise to 800 when the first start has to fetch models

input.name: Extra ComfyUI arguments
input.description: Extra flags appended to ComfyUI's launch line. CK attention is already on (see CK_ATTENTION)

input.name: Comfy Kitchen attention
input.description: Start ComfyUI with --use-ck-attention (needs the CUDA 13 build; set false only on a cu12 torch build)

input.name: ComfyUI log level
input.description: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR or CRITICAL

input.name: Refresh worker
input.description: Stop the worker after each job for a clean state

input.name: S3 access key ID
input.description: AWS access key ID (when S3 upload is enabled)

input.name: S3 secret access key
input.description: AWS secret access key (when S3 upload is enabled)
